levels.label: Absent or unsupported
levels.descriptor: No assessable individual P02 evidence or claims unsupported by any locator. No actual execution credit for a model labelled as actual.

levels.label: Partial and traceable
levels.descriptor: Traceable bounded individual implementation and some correctly classified protective cases, but compulsory cases/suites or provenance distinctions remain incomplete. Retain the omissions and limitations.

levels.label: Complete and supported
levels.descriptor: Complete permitted one-file P02 work with actual final baseline 2/2, objective 5/5, regression 3/3 and infrastructure 10/10 PASS, separately recorded in the strict p02_checks ledger with actual sanitised locators; traceable allow/forbid/conceal/state, trusted-input, one-load and bounded-snapshot evidence. Models are labelled separately and do not replace the normal actual suite gate.

levels.label: Absent or unsupported
levels.descriptor: No assessable CORS/CSRF evidence or an unbounded/all-five assertion without supporting records.

levels.label: Partial and traceable
levels.descriptor: One class has coherent trace, benign controls and correctly limited evidence, while the other is incomplete; or both have useful partial records with explicit omissions.

levels.label: Complete and supported
levels.descriptor: Both CORS and CSRF have source-to-decision traces, benign allow/refuse controls, the permitted boundary change, retained controls and explicit limitations. Actual reduced-P03 baseline 2/2, objective 4/4, regression 2/2, infrastructure 6/6 and successor inputs 12/12 PASS are recorded in the separate portfolio_patch ledger with actual sanitised locators; no two-class-to-all-five or pure-to-browser inference.

levels.label: Absent or unsupported
levels.descriptor: No genuine bounded exchange or no independent check. An actual access block is recorded honestly and referred to the real prior teacher assessment policy; no penalty or invented dialogue follows automatically from this descriptor.

levels.label: Partial and traceable
levels.descriptor: Actual bounded excerpts and a falsifiable sanitised claim are recorded, but the independent check, verdict or limitation is incomplete.

levels.label: Complete and supported
levels.descriptor: Genuine bounded actual exchange, independently checked claim, justified ACCEPTED/REJECTED/PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED/UNKNOWN verdict, correction and limitations. A reasoned UNKNOWN can earn critique credit; it does not establish implementation PASS. This candidate does not define alternative normal completion.

levels.label: Absent or unsupported
levels.descriptor: Records are untraceable/unreadable or confidentiality review and individual evidence distinction are absent. Sensitive evidence must be corrected through the teacher process; this proposal invents no institutional penalty.

levels.label: Partial and traceable
levels.descriptor: Readable individual locators and useful reflection exist, but source/environment/status/redaction/unfinished-work distinctions have gaps.

levels.label: Complete and supported
levels.descriptor: Readable reviewed PDF, exact source and measured environment, evidence classes, minimal redacted locators, honest outstanding work and reflection. P01 is an integration plan only; no full P01/advanced 11.3B is required.

no_double_count_rule: P02 technical correctness, portfolio reasoning, AI critique and evidence/reflection are different dimensions. Locators support attribution; they are not automatically four separate merits.
